# Raindance

> > Europe's leading independent film festival and film school, championing low-budget and DIY filmmaking since 1992.

Founded by Elliot Grove, Raindance operates the Raindance Film Festival in London's Leicester Square and provides education, resources, and community for independent filmmakers worldwide. The organization celebrates auteur cinema, emerging technologies like VR, and supports filmmakers from script to screen.

## Key Topics

- Independent filmmaking
- Low-budget production
- DIY filmmaking techniques
- Raindance Film Festival
- Screenwriting craft
- Film history and criticism
- Cinematography
- Film industry career advice
- Copyright and legal issues
- Mumblecore and indie genres
- VR and interactive cinema
- Auteur directors
- Film festival programming
- Production hacks
- Filmmaker interviews

## Filmmaker Resources & DIY Production

- [Cinema 2.0: Top Ten Production Hacks To DIY Success](https://raindance.org/top-ten-production-hacks-to-diy-success): Ten production hacks for microbudget DIY filmmaking success
- [Cinema 2.0: Camera Envy: Size Doesn't Matter](https://raindance.org/camera-envy-size-doesnt-matter): DIY filmmaking advice on camera equipment for low-budget productions
- [Get Handy With Copyright and the Internet](https://raindance.org/get-handy-with-copyright-and-the-internet): Copyright and fair use guide for filmmakers sharing content online
- [Achieving Your Vision For Your Film](https://raindance.org/achieving-vision-film): Director advice on maintaining creative vision during film production

## Screenwriting & Storytelling

- [5 Ways To Spice Things Up When You're Writing From A Formula](https://raindance.org/5-ways-to-spice-things-up-when-youre-writing-from-a-formula): Screenwriting tips for enhancing formulaic story structures creatively
- [7 Things You Must Steal From Billy Wilder](https://raindance.org/27027-2): Seven filmmaking lessons from legendary director Billy Wilder
- [The 5 Best Day Jobs for Aspiring Screenwriters](https://raindance.org/the-5-best-day-jobs-for-aspiring-screenwriters): Career advice on temporary jobs for aspiring screenwriters in Hollywood

## Film History & Cinematography

- [20 Films That Revolutionised Cinematography](https://raindance.org/15-20-films-revolutionized-cinematography): Film history guide featuring 20 revolutionary cinematography milestones
- [8 Essential Mumblecore Movies From The Low-Budget Genre](https://raindance.org/8-essential-mumblecore-movies-from-the-low-budget-genre): Essential mumblecore films guide from the low-budget indie genre
- [Movie Adaptations Of Hong Kong Action Comics](https://raindance.org/movie-adaptations-of-hong-kong-action-comics): Hong Kong action comics adapted to martial arts cinema features
